lines: seems to have died just now
In the brick ward, I couldn't sing right
A night hazed in fog, a red moon rising
Pray for the price of malice
Pay the price of cause and effect
There's a ringing in my ears
The barbed wire is so loud
I can't remember that day's melody
Black rain, fall on this sky
I am what no one wanted
To the bystanders I love, guilty of the same crime
Embracing the wound that won't erase

Pay the price of cause and effect
